# Proof & Realness

Legend: [D] demonstrated · [A] anticipated · [T] target.

- [A] "the pure like number evidence... number of people turning up the number of people participating number tokens number of um pentabytes of data and information total available" (asserted as future evidence, not shown).
- [T] Before/after sentiment: "we would have captured all the doom and gloom on the november's" then a later "survey evidence that now people are much more hopeful."
- [A] Per-guide impact: "every guide that is there is saying what change it has made and we just aggregate all that," assuming "by that time we've got some good metrics built into this" (unverified within the transcript).
- [T] Answers emerging: "we actually start getting answers and people start working on those answers and we start tracking that."
- [T] Conversions: "how many catholics if you're convinced" / nogen advocates "crossing the bench."

**Headline metric.** Whether the moment is emotional: "this moment being emotional and everyone being emotional about it would be the biggest indicator for me," "people should probably cry at this event."
